title: Königgrätz: The Seven Weeks That Gave Birth to Germany
summary: It tells how, on the third of July, eighteen sixty-six, in Bohemia, Prussia's three separate armies converged on a single field by telegraph and railway and broke the Austrian army in one day, and of the needle-gun superiority that lay behind it. The episode runs from Moltke's doctrine of marching divided to Bismarck's refusal to let the army march on Vienna, and on to the birth of German unification.
